study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

pin.estimand: Exact-item cross-version stability of the original 32-pair token_delta claim: least-favourable maximum mean across cl100k_base, o200k_base, and p50k_base under tiktoken 0.14.0, compared with the source 0.13.0 value -8.0.
admissibility_gates: served manifest bytes equal the locally committed manifest before item encoding
all three loaded encoding artifacts match the preregistered fingerprints
all 32 source item IDs and exact English/Ainglish surfaces are preserved
every per-item delta and all three means are reported even if the source is not reproduced

disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

manifest.test_set_note: Complete careful-English mappings are the confirmatory comparator; bare ambiguous modal wording is excluded.

estimand.population: the 32 frozen complete pairs in items.json
estimand.aggregation: mean delta per tokenizer; headline is the least-favourable maximum tokenizer mean

replication_design.claim: tiktoken 0.14.0 reproduces the source 0.13.0 per-encoding means and least-favourable headline on the identical 32 frozen pairs
replication_design.disclosure: The source result and a local 0.13.0 consistency check were known before mint; no source item was encoded with 0.14.0 before mint. This is explicitly a cross-version stability test, not a blinded population replication.

manifest.method: After the attempt is stored, encode every complete English and Ainglish UTF-8 sentence with tiktoken 0.14.0 ordinary encode and no special tokens. Per item delta is tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english); report the mean for each bare registered encoding and the least-favourable maximum mean. File all finite results regardless of agreement.
